purpose: Synthetic visual replacements; not recovered originals or measured tissue data.
base_color: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one seamless square PBR base-color/albedo texture map for the exterior serosal surface of a urinary bladder in a surgical robotics simulation, NOT a picture of a whole organ. Generate a 1024 by 1024 texture, a flat orthographic full-frame continuous material swatch, edge to edge. Pale warm ivory-pink living soft tissue with subtle muted salmon mottling, tiny faint branching capillaries, fine soft connective-tissue fiber variation. Healthy intact outer bladder wall, restrained low-contrast natural detail; avoid blood pools, injury, openings, fat lobules, strongly outlined large veins, mucosal folds or inner-bladder imagery. Pure diffuse albedo only: completely uniform ambient light, NO baked highlights, NO gloss reflections, NO shadow gradients, NO ambient occlusion, NO perspective, NO raised 3D silhouette, NO borders, NO checkerboard, NO labels, NO text. Seamless periodic edges in both axes, homogeneous low-frequency color throughout. This is an illustrative synthetic replacement material, not a diagnostic image. Output only the single usable texture map.
normal: Use case: precise-object-edit. The input is the base-color map for a synthetic outer urinary-bladder tissue material. Create its matching tangent-space NORMAL MAP, preserving the exact canvas and texture-feature positions. Output ONLY a single square usable RGB normal texture, not a preview render or multi-panel sheet. OpenGL convention +Y green, +Z blue; flat regions RGB (128,128,255), normal lengths approximately 1 after decoding RGB to [-1,1]. Very subtle surface relief only: fine shallow connective-tissue fibers and tiny tissue dimples, broad tissue and capillaries nearly flat. Predominantly pale periwinkle-blue (R/G very close to 128 and blue very close to 255); no dark blue regions, no dramatic creases, no deep cavities. Do not interpret pink color mottling as large geometric ridges. No lighting, shadows, labels, border, alpha, or baked shading. Seamless edge continuity in both directions. This is a conservative illustrative shader normal map, not medical ground truth.
roughness: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is an albedo map for synthetic outer urinary-bladder tissue. Create its corresponding single-channel-in-RGB GRAYSCALE ROUGHNESS texture, matching the exact image framing and positions of tissue fibers. Output ONLY the usable square texture, no diagram, labels or preview sphere. Neutral grayscale: RGB channels equal everywhere. Wet smooth healthy organ exterior: average pixel intensity 75/255, restrained subtle variation mostly between 60 and 95/255, very faint connective tissue fibers slightly rougher, no pure black or white. No directional lighting, highlights, baked shadows, large gradients, perspective or borders. Nearly uniform satin-smooth roughness with low-contrast fine organic detail. Seamless both directions. This is an illustrative art-directed roughness map, not measured tissue data. Preserve canvas size and feature positions of the input.
subsurface_weight: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the base-color image for a synthetic outer urinary-bladder tissue material. Create the matching SUBSURFACE SCATTERING WEIGHT texture, preserving exact square framing and locations of its tissue detail. Output only a single usable square grayscale texture; all RGB channels equal. This is a scalar data map: use mid-light gray, mean pixel around 175/255, low contrast mostly 155–190/255. Subtle smooth organic variation; small capillaries a little darker, connective tissue subtly lighter. Very conservative smooth homogeneous values, no pure black or white, no large gradients. NOT a photograph and NOT a rendered tissue surface. No baked lighting, cast shadows, bright highlights, perspective, borders, labels, diagrams or extra panels. Seamless across both axes. Designed as an illustrative artist-controlled blend weight, not a measured biological property.
